overall_safety_summary: The scene is generally managed well, but there is a safety concern regarding a pot handle protruding outwards from the stove, which poses a risk of accidental bumps and hot spills.

hazards.description: The handle of the pot containing boiling vegetables is pointing outwards to the right side of the stove.
hazards.explanation: A protruding handle can easily be bumped or snagged, risking knocking the pot over and causing severe burns from the hot liquid.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Older adults with mobility or balance challenges are at a higher risk of accidentally knocking into protruding handles.
hazards.recommended_action: Turn the pot handle inward so it is positioned safely over the stovetop and not sticking out.

uncertainties: Whether the burner under the saucepan with potatoes is turned on or hot.
